summary: Layer 1B expands the software node away from generic chatbot/model exposure and toward workflow-control assets where AI can be embedded into regulated or operational systems. The strongest underfollowed discovery lane in this pass is vertical SaaS with proprietary workflow data, compliance constraints, and measurable SaaS/ARR expansion. Elastic is included as a reference software infrastructure name for AI observability/security context; Intapp, nCino, and Cellebrite are underfollowed regulated-workflow candidates.
